  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming players and Alexa devices do not address the computer connection needs reflected in my WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, display cable, and USB-to-Ethernet adapter purchases.",
    "Having bought a tablet mount does not mean I need another tablet, and my older headset purchase does not give me a reason to replace my audio accessories now.",
    "The memory cards could serve a practical purpose, but I have no established storage need or confirmed device compatibility, so I would not choose either now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronics generally, including entertainment and home automation devices.",
    "The list seems to favor widely purchased devices, but their popularity does not establish that they solve a problem I currently have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, continuing a pattern of connecting devices and adding specific computer capabilities.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart and serve particular purposes; owning a related accessory does not mean I am ready to buy another device.",
    "For a connection accessory to interest me, its ports, supported devices, and operating-system compatibility need to fit my actual setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in electronics but miss my narrower pattern of buying practical accessories for specific connection needs."
}
